# War Scroll Column 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 14 | **Condition:** complete

---

**14:1** Blessed be the-God of-Israel, who-called us to-His-covenant and-did-not appoint our-lot with-the-congregation of-deceit.

**14:2** He-has-placed us in-the-lot of-truth, and-in-the-statutes of-righteousness He-has-caused-us-to-walk, and-in-the-judgments of-His-truth

**14:3** He-has-made-us-wise. We-shall-not-be-moved by-the-fury of-the-worthless, and-we-shall-not-be-terrified by-the-trials of-wickedness. For-You,

**14:4** O-God, are-terri[ble] in-the-glory of-Your-kingdom. And-the-congregation of-Your-holy-ones is in-our-midst for-eternal-strength. We-shall-heap-contempt upon-kings

**14:5** and-scorn upon-the-mighty. For holy is the-Lord, and-the-King of-Glory is with-us, the-people of-the-holy-ones of-His-covenant.

**14:6** The-teachers of-battle have-been-mustered, and-the-host of-His-spirits marches with-our-standards. Our-horsemen are as-clouds upon-the-horizon,

**14:7** as-mist of-dew upon-the-earth. And-after-the-slaying of-the-Kittim, the-congregation shall-stand in-that-place

**14:8** and-shall-bless the-God of-Israel. And-they-shall-respond and-say: Blessed be the-God of-Israel who-keeps

**14:9** covenant-faithfulness for-His-covenant and-appointed-times of-salvation for-the-people He-redeems. He-called those-who-stumble

**14:10** to-wonderful deliverances. And-the-assembly of-nations He-gathered for-annihilation without-remnant, to-raise-up in-judgment the-faint of-heart

**14:11** and-to-open the-mouth of-the-dumb for-songs-of-praise. To-teach the-hands of-the-weak to-make-war and-the-knees

**14:12** of-the-trembling to-be-girded-with-strength. Through-the-poor of-spirit You-will-judge a-hard-heart. Through-the-perfect

**14:13** of-way all the-wicked nations shall-come-to-an-end. All their-mighty-warriors shall-be-no-more. But-we, the-rem[nant of-Your-people],

**14:14** shall-praise Your-name, O-God of-mercies, who-keeps the-covenant with-our-fathers. And-in-all our-generations

**14:15** You-have-made Your-mercies wonderful for-the-rem[nant of-Your-people] under-the-dominion of-Belial. With-all the-mysteries of-his-enmity

**14:16** they-have-not-turned-us-away from-Your-covenant. His-spirits of-destruction You-have-driven from-us. And-when-the-men

**14:17** of-his-dominion acted-wickedly, You-preserved the-life of-Your-redeemed. You-raised-up the-fallen by-Your-strength and-cut-down all the-haughty-of-stature. And-there-is-no-deliverer for-all their-mighty-warriors and-no-refuge for-their-swift-ones.

---

*EMET notes: Column 14 contains the prayer and thanksgiving after battle, echoing key phrases from columns 11-12. The Kittim (14:7) are the eschatological enemy, typically identified as Romans. "Congregation of deceit" (14:1) is the opposite community designation to "congregation of holy ones." Lines 14:8-13 recapitulate the thanksgiving hymn of column 12. "Remnant of Your people" (14:13, 15) contains genuine manuscript damage. Construct chains hyphenated throughout.*
